# DueBird

> A homework tracker made for students, by students.

## What is DueBird?

DueBird helps students keep track of homework and assignments without
having to constantly ask their group chats.

## Features

- Keep class homework in one place.
- Add assignments.
- See what's due.
- Share classes with friends.
